generated.as:
case
          when value_int is not null then 'int'
          when value_float is not null then 'float'
          when value_string is not null then 'string'
          when value_time is not null then 'date'
          else '@none'
        end

subject_id::text
          || '|' || predicate
          || '|' || coalesce(object_id::text, '')
          || '|' || coalesce(value_int::text, '')
          || '|' || coalesce(value_float::text, '')
          || '|' || coalesce(value_string, '')
          || '|' || coalesce(value_time, '')
          || '|' || coalesce(start_time, '')
          || '|' || coalesce(end_time, '')

claims_value_arity.name: claims_value_arity
claims_value_arity.value:
case when "claims"."object_id" is not null then 0 else 1 end =
        (case when "claims"."value_int" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "claims"."value_float" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "claims"."value_string" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "claims"."value_time" is not null then 1 else 0 end)

claims_time_order.name: claims_time_order
claims_time_order.value: "claims"."start_order" is null or "claims"."end_order" is null or "claims"."end_order" >= "claims"."start_order"

claims_value_order.name: claims_value_order
claims_value_order.value: "claims"."value_order" is null or "claims"."value_time" is not null
